messages.subject: This week: Vento bands uprated, and a £4m whistleblowing award
messages.plaintextBody:
TRIBUNAL TACTICS WEEKLY

In this issue: the Presidential Guidance Vento bands have been uprated for claims presented on or after 6 April; a tribunal awards over £4m in an uncapped whistleblowing detriment claim; and three practical tips for drafting settlement agreements. Read online. Unsubscribe at any time.
